description: WattCoin: Aggregate WattCoin statistics as JSON. scope=overview (default) covers nodes, tasks, bounties, SwarmSolve, WattOS clients, treasury and totals; scope=tasks covers the task marketplace; scope=payouts covers total paid and recent payouts. Use get_task_leaderboard instead for per-agent rankings. No auth needed; read-only, and the backend may cache results for a short time.

scope.description: overview (default) = whole ecosystem, tasks = task marketplace stats, payouts = bounty payout stats

name: get_ecosystem_stats
title: WattCoin: Get ecosystem stats
